newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Nordstrom rises.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Nordstrom rises.

text.p: Shares in Nordstrom Inc rose in trading ahead of the opening on Wall Street Tuesday after the retailer posted better-than-expected second quarter results.
One trader cited Nordstrom at 58-7/8 and another said the stock traded at 59, up from its close Monday at 57-14/16.
After the market's close on Monday, Seattle-based Nordstrom posted second quarter earnings of $0.76 a share, topping Wall Street's consensus estimate of $0.68.
In other pre-opening dealings USA Detergents Inc was trading at 12-3/8, down from its Monday close at 13-4/16 after the company said would restate its 1996 results.

The New Brunswick, N.J. company said late Monday it found errors in its 1996 results and would restate those figures to show adjustments that would hurt 1996 results of operations by about $1.3 million, net of tax.

Traders said dealings were generally quite, with investors holding back ahead of Producer Price Index data Wednesday and Consumer Price Index data Thursday. "It's like everybody's waiting for Wednesday and Thursday," one trader said.
